summary: Independent persistent write owner for Decision Journal entries (services/governance/decision_journal.py): create/patch/get/list plus audit trail, backed by the existing governance JSON/Postgres owner-store posture (record_store.build_governance_record_store), with compare-and-set concurrency control and idempotent create/patch. Fixes the review-rejected race: patch_entry now claims the idempotency_key with an atomic insert_if_absent reservation before any entry mutation, so a concurrent conflicting request_hash gets 'conflict' and a concurrent identical retry waits and replays -- neither ever performs a second compare-and-set/audit write. No import of services/control-plane/bff/read_store.py, no local dict/overlay/cache fallback; BFF main.py and read_store.py are untouched, and services/source_ingestion remains reconcile-only (not touched).
verification: $PANTHEON_PY -m pytest -q tests/governance_write_owner (13 passed, incl. 2 barrier-forced concurrent idempotency regression tests)
